submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: one single independently drawn animation frame for existing game pet Zhuling (烛翎), highest polished painterly quality. Preserve exact original existing bird identity, proportions, indigo feathers, copper-red wing panels, amber cloud crown, ivory silk neck scarf, celadon candle pendant fixed to neck, golden edged SHORT fan tail. Exactly two bird wings, two tucked bird feet and one short tail; no humanoid arms, no phoenix. Images 1-2 are identity and angle references; image 3 is the principal confirmed clean rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted material/style reference only: DO NOT draw UI. Maintain detailed softly painted feathers and subtle gold accents. Produce ONLY ONE complete bird, no text, no panel, no contact sheet, no duplicates, no floor, no glow aura or attack effects. A genuinely transparent background with clean natural alpha, no colored fringe. Square 1024x1024 RGBA. Locked camera/scale: chest-abdomen center about (512,590), hovering feet bottoms around y=880, virtual anchor (512,942); all wing tips, crest, silk and short tail stay inside x100..924, y100..930. Body may move naturally <=20px; never walk/run or translate entire subject. The anatomical RIGHT wing, the near wing in both angles, performs a short forward horizontal sweep while the beak does a short peck along facing direction. Far anatomical LEFT wing stays visible and balances. Feet remain tucked under belly, ornaments stay attached. Each frame must be freshly AI rendered with the specified pose.
DIRECTION E: true three-quarter FRONT-RIGHT view facing diagonally screen lower-right. Chest and face visible, anatomical RIGHT wing is the near wing on screen LEFT. Image 1 E is primary angle identity, Image 2 W supplemental anatomy only. Keep original reference camera and body scale; do not shrink bird further.
Frame 6 of 12, 30ms. POSE: Acceleration just before impact: head and closed beak thrust forward/down-right relative to chest, NEAR anatomical RIGHT wing (screen-left shoulder in E) sweeps FORWARD ACROSS LOWER CHEST toward attack direction; elbow moves forward, feather fan reaches toward lower-right and foreshortens, no longer upright V. Far LEFT wing extends high behind for balance. Body leans about 8 degrees into peck but remains centered. In W maintain rear-right camera and sweep right near wing toward UPPER-LEFT facing direction instead. Exactly TWO wings connected to same shoulder roots, two tucked feet.
Make this specified physical pose clearly different from reference neutral pose, while keeping exact identity.
